name: Webhook Upload Ingress
description: Authenticated file-upload ingress: clients upload files, each batch goes to an agent through /hooks/agent, and an outgoing folder is served back.

configSchema.description: EITHER inline settings OR configFile (a JSON file with the same keys); next to configFile only service_name and identity_header may be set, as overrides.

configFile.description: Path to a JSON config file with the keys below (~ expands). Excludes the inline settings.

allowed_logins.description: Identity-header values that are allowed (set by the trusted reverse proxy).

identity_header.description: Request header holding the proxy-verified identity.

token_file.description: File (mode exactly 0600) holding the Bearer token clients may use instead of an identity header.

openclaw_config.description: OpenClaw config whose hooks.token authenticates /hooks/agent calls. Default: $OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH, else ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.

gateway_url.description: Gateway base URL; batches are posted to <gateway_url>/hooks/agent.

intake_url.description: Optional URL that receives one JSON incident when a batch exhausts dispatch_attempts.

outgoing.description: Directory of files served back to clients. Default: ~/.openclaw/webhook-upload-ingress/outgoing.

state_dir.description: Directory for relay-state.json and the mode file. Default: ~/.openclaw/webhook-upload-ingress/state.

quiet_period.description: Seconds without new files before a batch is dispatched.

service_name.description: Name used in the Server header, log lines and incident ids.

hook.description: The /hooks/agent payload fields; only configured fields are sent.

instruction.description: First line of the message the agent receives.
